name: Skylib
english_description: Version 1.8 of Skylib, an English-language LPMud library in the Discworld/Nightmare lineage (boot banner: "Divided Sky Distribution Lib"), built around the same soul/directory-based command dispatch as Discworld rather than the driver's native add_action(). Porting it surfaced two especially wide-reaching FluffOS-compat bugs beyond the usual .c-to-.lpc rename side effects (found in 11 files, not just __FILE__ comparisons): the archive's own bundled include/runtime_config.h used a stale, mismatched get_config() index numbering that silently returned wrong-typed values instead of erroring, and -- the big one -- this driver build compiles WITH native add_action() support, which this mudlib barely uses, so its own command-dispatch fallback into the real command() efun always failed silently and its process_input() apply always told the driver "unhandled," causing every single typed command to be swallowed and doubly rejected with "What?" before the mudlib's real directory-based dispatcher (cmdAll/new_parser/lower_check) ever ran. Fixed with a small set of #if efun_defined(add_action)-gated compat shims. What works after fixing: full registration, login, and the real player command set (look/score/inventory/quit and more), verified live. A first-boot "creator only mode" lockdown (this lib's own safety default on any fresh install) required a save-file edit to open registration and to seed the project's admin account into the archive's own placeholder admin-group entry. Roughly 127 of 2163 files still fail lpcc's standalone compile sweep, almost all pre-existing content gaps predating this port (deliberately-broken LPC-error teaching examples, master.lpc mixins that only compile as part of the whole object, a dead/superseded alternate room-topography system, obsolete std/guilds/old/* content calling a set_race() function that was renamed/removed mudlib-wide, missing marry.h/rituals.h headers, and one file shipped in the original archive itself as a single line with zero newlines) -- logged in NOTES.md, not fixed, per this project's content-vs-driver-compat scope. Like imud/foundation2, this lib makes a real outbound Intermud-3 socket connection at boot (to a near-certainly-defunct 1990s host) and should not be swept into high-frequency automated re-boot loops.
